 Court No. - 8
 Hon'Ble Manish Kumar, J.
The applicant has filed an objection against the compliance affidavit, which is taken on record.
The present contempt application has been preferred against the alleged non compliance of the order dated 03.01.2025 passed in Writ C No. 11051 of 2024.

The relevant paragraph of the same is quoted hereinbelow:-
"5.
This is not a matter where we can decide such factual issues.

Petitioner may approach the concerned authorities raising his grievance in the matter which may be got inquired and his entitlement to rehabilitation under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 shall be considered and a decision shall be taken with expedition unless there is any legal impediment in this regard in which case the same shall be communicated to the petitioner.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Let this exercise be completed within three months."

Learned Standing Counsel has submitted that the compliance affidavit has already been filed enclosing therein the copy of the order dated 01.12.2025, by which the decision has been taken in the case of the applicant whereby the total compensation has been paid and the land has been allotted to the applicant.

On the other hand, learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that when the applicant tried to construct a wall on the land, the neighbours started raising objection and he had to stop the work so the judgment and order passed by the writ Court has not been complied with.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record of the case, it is found that there was a direction to take a decision regarding the his entitlement to rehabilitation under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and the said decision has been taken by the authorities, so the judgment and order passed by the writ Court has been complied with, even then the applicant is still aggrieved, he may avail the remedies as may be permissible under the law.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: In view of above, the present contempt application is dismissed as infructuous.
